title: [finding] claimOrgSeedOwnership re-owns seeded rows with an isSystem-only context, so every metadata-bound hook and record-change flow runs for a bookkeeping write (the twin of #22067, whose fix reached only claimSeedOwnership)
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the seat's review of cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2794 (objectstack-ai/cloud#2789). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

`claimOrgSeedOwnership` hands an organization's owner-less seeded rows to its owner. It writes each row with `{ isSystem: true }` and nothing else. objectstack#22067 measured what that context does on HotCRM: an `isSystem`-only owner write runs every metadata-bound app hook and dispatches record-change flows, so approvals open and notification emails go out for a bookkeeping write. #22069 (`e67ba80049`) fixed it for `claimSeedOwnership` only, by adding `skipAutomations: true`. The organization claim was not changed.

## Evidence

- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/claim-org-seed-ownership.ts` on `main` `6a7eca68`, line 35: `const SYSTEM_CTX = { isSystem: true };`. Every update goes through it (`ql.update(schema.name, { id, owner_id }, { context: SYSTEM_CTX })`, line 93 at `56bf27affb`).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:4185-4205` (at `56bf27affb`): `session.skipAutomations` skips hooks bound from metadata, while code-registered hooks (audit, capability gates, sharing projection) still run. So the flag is available, and it keeps security and audit intact.
- #22069's landing note: with `{ isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true }` the claim "fires no metadata-bound hook and dispatches no record-change flow".

## Who reaches it

- The framework's multi-tenant standalone path: `ensureDefaultOrganization` calls it when an organization is created.
- Cloud, from PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2794: after a hosted seed replay, cloud calls it to hand HotCRM sample rows to the organization owner, on install and once as a backfill on every installed environment. Cloud will pass an engine adapter that adds the flag until this function carries it; that adapter retires with the fix.

## Also observed (the dev's reading, not measured further)

The claim reads up to `limit: 10_000` ids per object and updates one row at a time, where `claimSeedOwnership` moved to paged predicate writes (objectstack#14530, #14719). An object above 10,000 owner-less rows would be claimed in part.

## Wanted

The organization claim writes with `{ isSystem: true, skipAutomations: true }`, with the pin #22069 added for its twin (a metadata-bound hook does not run, a code-registered hook does). The paging is the same family and may ride along.

Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for `claimOrgSeedOwnership`, `skipAutomations` and seed ownership: #22067, #21486, #17628, #14719 and #14530 are all about `claimSeedOwnership` or its timing, all closed.
